item.title: UK Account Executive - SMB
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and an ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250.000 users in 90 countries around the world.

Working at Teamtailor means working at a global, international, and fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organisation and are craving for responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun!!! 🥳

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning, and is truly a part of our strength today! There are no typical profiles, except that every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of our success. Join us in our mission to help companies and people interact with each other in a better way so that they can make life-changing decisions together.

We are now looking for an Account Executive to join the team from our Farringdon office - this role is perfect for someone who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and loves building their own book of business!

We work hard and have lots of fun along the way, but every call counts, and we're looking for someone who takes real accountability for their numbers and stays proactive about hitting them, not just aiming for them. You will be instrumental in driving Teamtailor's growth across the SMB+Mid-Market segment, running high-velocity sales cycles from first contact through to close.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership and accountability of your pipeline and your numbers, treating every call and every deal as if it's the one that matters most

  • Build and nurture your own book of business through proactive, self-generated, multi-channel outreach, never waiting for pipeline to come to you

  • Run structured, consultative discovery and use MEDDPICC diligently to qualify every opportunity

  • Manage a high volume of fast-moving deals with a high degree of detail and accuracy

  • Keep pipeline hygiene and CRM data clean, accurate and up to date at all times, no exceptions

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to each prospect's needs

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success and the wider Sales team to ensure smooth handovers at close

  • Provide reliable weekly and monthly forecasts you can be held to

  • Consistently and proactively hit your monthly and quarterly revenue targets, and take ownership when a number is at risk rather than waiting to be asked

  • Bring your experience selling in the tech space to help upskill the wider team

We are looking for someone with:

  • A track record of selling in the tech space, ideally SaaS, with a genuine passion for sharing that knowledge with the team

  • Experience working in a high-performance, target-driven sales culture, where you're comfortable being held to your numbers

  • A strong sense of personal accountability and ownership - you treat your pipeline like your own business and don't need to be chased to stay on top of it

  • Genuinely proactive by nature - you spot when a number is slipping and act on it before anyone has to flag it

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing several fast-moving deals at once

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework

  • Excellent pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline (Salesforce & Gong experience preferred)

  • Emotional intelligence and strong communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships with prospects

  • An inquisitive, hungry mindset - always looking to improve and develop

  • The ability to take feedback well and act on it quickly

  • A team-first attitude, willing to share knowledge and support colleagues

What we have to offer:

  • The opportunity to sell the market's leading employer branding and recruitment platform

  • Fixed salary together with a variable commission plan, we apply a generous model with no cap

  • Company pension

  • Development opportunities in a fast-growing environment, continuous training, and support

  • Generous PTO (25 days) and you will be able to attend our yearly 3-day company trip

  • Tons of team events, celebrations, monthly competitions and rewards for those who like challenges

  • Starter kit which includes a Macbook Air, iPhone, and the must-have Teamtailor merch, free breakfast and fika

  • The opportunity to work with a talented, fun and kind group of individuals, based in our Farringdon office

If this sounds like you, then you know what to do!

item.title: Customer Success Manager - Sydney
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and an ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 200k users in 90 countries around the world 🌏.

Working at Teamtailor means working at an international fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organization and are craving responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun 🥳.

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning and is truly part of its strength today! There are no typical profiles, each and every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of its success.

That's why we're expanding our Customer Success department and looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager based in Sydney. Our mission is to have the most satisfied customers, and we are looking for a strong relationship-builder to join our team and take care of our APAC clients 🙌🏼

Within the Customer Success department, you will find Customer Success Managers, Product Specialists, Promote Specialists, Onboarding Specialists, Data Transfer Specialists, Implementation Managers, who are located in Sweden, Finland, Spain, Colombia, Canada, the US, New Zealand and Australia 👨 👩 👧 👦.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Implement and onboard new customers.

  • Help our customers unlock the full potential of Teamtailor, with everything from marketplace integrations and best practices to training opportunities.

  • Work as a strategic advisor & goal-oriented for our customers.

  • Work proactively with renewals.

  • Build strong relationships.🤝

  • Identify new business opportunities with our existing portfolio customers through expansion sales, upselling, and cross-selling. 💰

  • Collect and analyze customers' feedback and present it internally

  • Together, develop and improve ways of working with customer satisfaction.

As a Customer Success Manager at Teamtailor, you will be offered:

  • Responsibility for your own customer base

  • Incredible development opportunities

  • The opportunity to work with the market's best product

  • Fixed salary with commission benefits

  • Be part of a great multicultural team.

Is this you?

  • 4+ Years of Customer Success Experience 🥷🏼

  • Experience in SaaS

  • Experience in HR or Recruiting

  • Experience in project leading, especially complex projects

  • Communication, listening, collaboration, adaptability, empathy, and negotiation skills

  • Engaged, creative, and solution-oriented

  • Have the mindset willing to learn and try new things

  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment and rapidly changing market

  • Based in Sydney

We value your personality and we believe you're passionate about your work, ambitious, and work hard to reach your own goals!🥰

item.title: Regional Director CSM
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and an ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users in 90 countries around the world 🌏.

Working at Teamtailor means working at an international fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organization and are craving responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun 🥳.

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning and is truly part of its strength today! There are no typical profiles, each and every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of its success.

That's why we're expanding our Customer Success department and looking for an experienced Regional Director CSM in Stockholm. Our mission is to have the most satisfied customers, and we are looking for a person to join our team and be a part of this global journey 🙌🏼

The Role

The Regional Director CSM is responsible for driving operational excellence within the CSM function. This person leads and supports the CSM Team Managers, ensuring that daily execution runs smoothly, processes are followed, and customer cases are resolved efficiently. They act as a multiplier for the Director Customer Success, empowering the team to deliver consistent results while ensuring alignment with strategic decisions and direction.

A key purpose of the role is to continuously strengthen customer experience and business impact, driving improvements in NPS, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and overall customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

  • Lead and support the CSM Team Managers in their daily responsibilities.

  • Serve as the first escalation point for operational or customer-related challenges for Team Managers.

  • Run structured 1:1s and coaching sessions with Team Managers to ensure consistency and growth.

Operations & Execution

  • Own the execution of agreed CS strategies, playbooks, and processes. Follow up and evaluate.

  • Ensure customer cases are handled effectively and escalations are resolved at the right level.

  • Drive accountability for core CS metrics (e.g., NRR, retention, adoption, health scores).

  • Monitor workloads and ensure the team is operating efficiently.

Process, Tools & Reporting

  • Ensure tools, systems, and workflows are adopted and used consistently across the CSM organization.

  • Manage reporting on CSM performance and team effectiveness.

  • Provide insights to the Director Customer Success for continuous improvement, such as challenges, opportunities, bottlenecks, strengths, etc.

  • Support the Director Customer Success with cross-functional projects.

Decision-Making & Collaboration

  • Act with mandate on day-to-day matters and operational decisions already aligned with strategy.

  • Collaborate closely with the Director Customer Success, influencing decision-making through input and analysis.

  • Escalate and align on strategic or structural decisions that go beyond daily execution.

Success in this Role Looks Like

  • Team Managers feel supported, coached, and empowered to lead their teams effectively.

  • Daily CS operations run smoothly.

  • Clear reporting and insights are consistently delivered, enabling better decision-making.

  • Processes are followed and continuously improved.

  • Key success indicators show measurable improvement, including higher NPS, stronger Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and increased customer satisfaction and engagement.

  • The Director Customer Success can focus on strategic direction, knowing day-to-day execution is in safe hands.

Experience & Requirements

  • Proven experience leading and developing Customer Success teams, including 1:1s, performance reviews, feedback, and coaching.

  • Experience running effective 1:1s, performance reviews, feedback sessions, and fostering team development.

  • Skilled in managing day-to-day operations, including workload balancing, process compliance, and customer case handling, and consistent ways of working.

  • Strong understanding of CS metrics and performance management, including NRR, retention, adoption, and NPS. With the ability to analyse data, identify trends and bottlenecks, and drive improvements.

  • Experience with CS tools and systems (e.g., CRM, health scoring, reporting dashboards) and ensuring process consistency.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator, able to influence and align Sales, CS, Support, and other teams around shared customer outcomes.

  • Hans-on, structured, and dependable, with a strong sense of ownership and initiative, bringing clarity, stability, and energy to both the team and leadership.

You will be offered

  • Leading CSM Team Managers globally.

  • Development opportunities.

  • The opportunity to work with the market's best product.

  • Fixed salary with commission benefits.

  • Be part of a great multicultural team.

We value your personality and we believe you're passionate about your work, ambitious, and work hard to reach your own goals!
